authorization: User permits different internal function graphs for individually identified embedded CRT routines, preserving their ABI, observable behavior and shared data contracts.
originating_runtime: Unidentified; differs from the shipped LIBC/LIBCMT/MSVCRT10 allocator implementation.

compatible_runtime_variants.evidence: Full target and CLOSE.OBJ compared: equivalent swapped unsigned bounds comparison; remaining body/branches and call graph preserve close/error/standard-handle behavior.
Full target and OSFINFO.OBJ compared: equivalent bounds comparison and register allocation; same open flags, invalid-handle errors, SetStdHandle and state writes.

CRT0DAT.OBJ wrapper relocation identifies the common CRT exit routine. Library retains reverse onexit callbacks, preterminator/terminator tables, return flag and ExitProcess ABI/calls. Library additionally sets a private termination-done flag; original has no corresponding native-observable flag. Native constructors are empty and stdio owns the shared exit flag.

reconstructed_runtime_variants.reason: 512-byte original versus larger shipped LIBC buffer caused a measured paired flush frontier mismatch. Original allocation/fallback and call set reconstructed.
Preserve original buffer size and Ctrl-Z bookkeeping across standard FILE operations. Original full body and call set reconstructed.
Target clears _IOMYBUF only; library additionally clears 0x400. Small recovered body retains original FILE flags.
